info.name: Job Autofill Copilot — Full E2E Test Suite
info.description:
Complete end-to-end test collection for all backend API endpoints.

IMPORTANT: Run requests in folder order (Health → Users → Resumes → Templates → Applications → AI Agents).

Collection variables are auto-set by test scripts — you only need to set OPENAI_API_KEY and CLERK_TOKEN before running.

See README tab for setup instructions.

request.description: Kubernetes liveness probe — always 200 if the process is running.

Returns the authenticated user's profile. Requires valid Bearer token.

request.description:
Upload an encrypted resume file. The file is stored in MinIO (S3) and a Celery task is dispatched to parse it.

⚠️ You MUST select an actual PDF/DOCX file in the 'file' form-data field.
Returns resume metadata. If parse_status=complete, also includes parsed_data JSON.

Parses a simulated Greenhouse application form HTML.

Phase 1 (heuristic) will resolve most fields instantly.
Phase 2 (LLM) handles ambiguous ones.

Expected: platform_detected=greenhouse, fields with first_name/last_name/email etc. mapped correctly, cover_letter and why_us marked as requires_ai=true.

request.description:
The most critical endpoint. Retrieves context from Qdrant (resume + template + past answers) and generates a grounded answer.

Key things to verify:
- confidence_score > 0.5 means good context coverage
- hallucination_flagged should be false
- context_sources should list where the answer drew from
- refusal_reason should be null if answer was generated
